Running Python code interactively: import struct

def inst(opcode, *operands):
    words = [opcode]
    words.extend(operands)
    wc = len(words)  # total words including header
    out = struct.pack('<I', (wc << 16) | opcode)
    for w in words[1:]:
        out += struct.pack('<I', w)
    return out

def string_operand(s):
    b = s.encode('utf-8') + b'\x00'
    while len(b) % 4 != 0:
        b += b'\x00'
    return list(struct.unpack('<%dI' % (len(b)//4), b))

magic = struct.pack('<I', 0x07230203)
version = struct.pack('<I', 0x00010000)
generator = struct.pack('<I', 0)
bound = struct.pack('<I', 20)
schema = struct.pack('<I', 0)

ids = {'void':1,'voidfn':2,'float':3,'Inner':4,'Outer':5,'ptr':6,'var':7,'main':8,'entry':9}

body = b''
body += inst(17, 1)  # OpCapability Shader
body += inst(14, 0, 0)  # OpMemoryModel Logical Simple
body += inst(15, 7, ids['main'], *string_operand('main'))  # OpEntryPoint Fragment %main "main"
body += inst(16, ids['main'], 0)  # OpExecutionMode %main OriginUpperLeft
body += inst(5, ids['Outer'], *string_operand('Outer'))  # OpName
body += inst(5, ids['Inner'], *string_operand('Inner'))
body += inst(6, ids['Outer'], 0, *string_operand('inner'))  # OpMemberName
body += inst(6, ids['Inner'], 0, *string_operand('a'))
body += inst(6, ids['Inner'], 1, *string_operand('b'))
body += inst(6, ids['Inner'], 2, *string_operand('c'))
body += inst(71, ids['Outer'], 2)  # OpDecorate %Outer Block
body += inst(72, ids['Outer'], 0, 35, 4)  # OpMemberDecorate %Outer 0 Offset 4
body += inst(72, ids['Inner'], 0, 35, 0)
body += inst(72, ids['Inner'], 1, 35, 4)
body += inst(72, ids['Inner'], 2, 35, 8)
body += inst(71, ids['var'], 3, 0)  # OpDecorate %var DescriptorSet 0
body += inst(71, ids['var'], 33, 0)  # OpDecorate %var Binding 0
body += inst(19, ids['void'])  # OpTypeVoid
body += inst(33, ids['voidfn'], ids['void'])  # OpTypeFunction
body += inst(22, ids['float'], 32)  # OpTypeFloat 32
body += inst(30, ids['Inner'], ids['float'], ids['float'], ids['float'])  # OpTypeStruct Inner
body += inst(30, ids['Outer'], ids['Inner'])  # OpTypeStruct Outer
body += inst(32, ids['ptr'], 2, ids['Outer'])  # OpTypePointer Uniform %Outer
body += inst(59, ids['var'], ids['ptr'], 2)  # OpVariable %ptr Uniform
body += inst(54, ids['main'], ids['void'], 0, ids['voidfn'])  # OpFunction
body += inst(248, ids['entry'])  # OpLabel
body += inst(253)  # OpReturn
body += inst(56)  # OpFunctionEnd

spv = magic + version + generator + bound + schema + body
open('/workspace/poc.spv','wb').write(spv)
print('wrote', len(spv), 'bytes')

# verify
data = open('/workspace/poc.spv','rb').read()
words = struct.unpack('<%dI' % (len(data)//4), data)
i = 5
while i < len(words):
    wc = words[i] >> 16
    op = words[i] & 0xffff
    print(i, hex(words[i]), 'wc=',wc, 'op=',op)
    i += wc
